Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph AUG 16 2019 OILG OPINION NO. 48 EXEC. DIR. JULIUS D. GUTIERREZ Executive Director and COO National Youth Commission Yd Flr., West Insula Building, # 135 West Avenue cor. EDSA Brgy. Bungad, Quezon City Dear Executive Director Gutierrez: S. 202- This is in reference to your letter dated 25 June 2019 requesting this Department's opinion on the following, and we quote: I) "Whether the validity of applying Rule V, Section 2 of R.A. 8044 is proper in the premises which gives rise to the question as to; 2) Whether the presence of OIC Paul Anthony Pangilinan, and Commissioner Del Rosario and Ventura is sufficient as to constitute a Commission Proper in light of circumstances, thus enabling the OIC to perform acts necessary as provided in the NYC mandate. " Foremost, this Department understands the situation of your Office and it is with all intention to help ease the situation. However, helping your Office is not without limitations. In doing so, this Department also ensures that it will not violate any law or regulation. In your letter, you inquired on the application of Section 2, Rule V of the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of R.A. No. 8044 otherwise known as "The Youth in Nation-Building Act" provides: "Section 2. Temporary and Permanent Vacancy in the Office of the Chairperson — When the Chairperson is temporarily unable or incapacitated to perform his duties, for physical or legal reasons, such as but not limited to leave of absence, travel whether locally or abroad, and there are necessary matters to be attended to, he may designate in writing a Commissioner to serve as Commissioner-in- charge. Such designation shall be automatically revoked when the Chairperson reports back to Office.

In case of death, permanent disability, removal from office or resignation of the Chairperson. the Commissioners shall elects from among themselves a Commissioner-in-charge to the Chair erson until the new Chair ers n shal have been appointed Che President and have qualified. " (emphasis ours) It must be noted that this provision is applicable only when there is vacancy, whether permanent or temporary, in the Office of the Chairperson. Yet, it presupposes that the other membersl of the Commission Proper are present. In the herein case, only 2 Commissioners and an Officer-in-charge remain in the Commission Proper and the other offices were vacant. Moreover, the above-cited provision of the IRR should not be taken separately but should be considered in conjunction with Sections 6 and 7, Rule V of the same IRR, viz: "Section 6. Quorum. — A quorum is required before the Commission can do business. A quorum shall only be declared when there are at least four (4) Commissioners physically present. The presence of quorum is presumed to continue until the end of the meeting unless the issue of quorum is timely raised in the same meeting. " Section 7. Decisions. - Decisions of the Commission shall be arrived at by majority vote in a meeting where there a quorum. Hence, it appears that this provision is inapplicable because the Commissioners cannot do business anymore due to the lack of sufficient number to constitute a quorum. On the contrary, it must be noted that this provision was already fulfilled when DILG, through Department Order 2019-585 issued on 4 June 2019, designated Commissioner Paul Anthony M. Pangilinan as Commissioner-in-charge. You also represented in your letter that on 20 June 2019, the Legal Officer of the NYC issued a legal opinion, explaining that in light of the circumstances, the Quorum requirement as provided by R.A. No. 8044 may be dispensed with, in pursuance to the "liberality provision" as found in Section 2, Rule II of the IRR of R.A. No. 8044 which provides: "Section 2. Interpretation. — These Rules shall be interpreted with liberality to better achieve the objectives of R.A. 8044. " 1 Section 1, Rule IV (A) of IRR of RA 8044 — Composition. — The National Youth Commission Proper shall be composed of the Chairperson, two Commissioners chosen at large, the Commissioners representing Luzon, Visayas and Mindanao, and the President of the Pambansang Katipunan ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan who shall serve in an ex- officio capacity — duly amended by RA 10742 as there is no Pambansang Pederasyon ng SK

We understand the herein liberality clause of the IRR. However, it must be noted that a specific number to constitute quorum was also specified in the IRR, as it indicated that quorum shall only be declared when there are at least four (4) Commissioners physically present. Since this provision is clear and unequivocal, it leave no room for the Department to interpret the same, but only to apply what is provided by the law and its IRR. In support with the herein position, the Supreme Court said: "Time and time again, it has been repeatedly declared by this Court that where the law speaks in clear and categorical language. there is no room for interpretation. There is only room for application. Absolute Sentencia Expositore Non Indiget, when the language of the law is clear, no explanation of it is required. 'Q It must be remembered also that the law intended the NYC Proper to decide as a collegiate body. Henceforth, it provided for the number of members necessary to transact any business. In such liberal interpretation provided in your letter, the said intention of the law will be defeated if it will allow only few persons, setting aside the requirement of quorum, to decide for the Commission. Lastly, it is suggested that this problem of the NYC should be persistently raised to the Office of the President as it has the power to resolve the problem of NYC, in coordination with this Department, specifically the Office of Assistant Secretary Marjorie N. Jalosjos for any possible assistance. Thank you. Uls/37 2 Barcellano vs Bahas, G.R. NO. 165287, September 14, 2011 Very y yo s, E ARD Secreta DI LG„OBEC . ANO
